scope: Windows Server 2022; four independent new-process/new-fixture runs per version on the same runner, AB/BA/AB/BA. OS/file caches not cleared. Three reply snapshots averaged within each run. heapScope: Separate instrumented diagnostics with sampled allocation and a strong-edge dominator estimator. Snapshot collection can GC; later cumulative allocation includes earlier profiler/snapshot processing. Top retained rows overlap. Native/renderer/GPU memory is not fully covered. Never treat diagnostic WS/PB or sampled allocations as ordinary RAM.
